subject.title: [Bug]: Telegram DMs can still land in agent:main:main, polluting heartbeat/main session after #40519

question: Should maintainers split this issue so explicit heartbeat-session precedence lands first while Telegram default DM isolation stays a separate compatibility decision?
rationale: The heartbeat precedence path is a source-provable bug, but changing Telegram DMs away from documented main-session sharing would alter established routing behavior for existing users.

options.title: Split heartbeat fix first
options.body: Adopt or replace the heartbeat wake/session repair so configured heartbeat sessions win, and leave default DM isolation controlled by `session.dmScope` until separately approved.

options.title: Bundle Telegram isolation
options.body: Change Telegram DMs to isolate by default in the same work, accepting docs, tests, and upgrade impact for users relying on main-session continuity.

options.title: Defer to heartbeat entries
options.body: Hold this behind native per-session heartbeat scheduling, which may be cleaner long term but leaves the current forced-session path unresolved.

recommendation.title: Split heartbeat fix first
recommendation.body: Adopt or replace the heartbeat wake/session repair so configured heartbeat sessions win, and leave default DM isolation controlled by `session.dmScope` until separately approved.

likelyOwner.reason: The central heartbeat runner history points to `steipete`, and this decision affects core session/routing behavior.
